office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in the county's courts and advises county officials. Partisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Amy S. Vira, Prosecuting Attorney since 2023 and a longtime deputy before that, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County Prosecuting Attorney for one term after more than a decade as a deputy prosecutor; prefers the Democratic Party; the only candidate.
highlights: One term as Prosecuting Attorney; deputy prosecutor for over a decade before [S1]
Civil work on land use, public records and liability as well as criminal cases [S1]
Unopposed in the primary: 4,812 votes to 241 write-ins [S3]
